Reload history and follow an image-version anchor
expectedOutcomes: Message order and anchor identity are retained
Resolution and discussion sequence change without altering project timing

scenarios.title: Author exact script source and boundaries — ScriptTextViews
plannedActions: Open a synthetic script, edit text and selection, split and merge a line
Move or delete a line, save, undo and reopen the project
expectedOutcomes: Authored text, stable IDs and unaffected neighboring content match the intended edit
Boundary operations preserve scene order and saved project invariants

scenarios.title: Inspect responsive screen layout — ScriptTextViews
plannedActions: Open the target screen at narrow and wide workspace sizes
Change zoom and inspect visible controls, scroll content and typography
expectedOutcomes: Required controls remain reachable without unintended clipping or overlap
Layout and text sizing follow the selected width and zoom while keeping content readable

scenarios.title: Create characters and confirm source identities — ScriptTextViews
plannedActions: Create or edit a character and inspect its script mentions or pictured tags
Confirm or change an identity link and save/reopen
expectedOutcomes: Names, aliases and identity references match the chosen character
Unrelated text, portraits and image associations remain unchanged

scenarios.title: Seek, follow and stop playback — ScriptTextViews
plannedActions: Select an entry or word and start playback from its source position
Toggle follow, pause and resume while switching the active surface
expectedOutcomes: The playhead and highlighted source reflect the chosen timeline position
Pause, surface changes and follow settings retain consistent control state

scenarios.title: Inspect responsive screen layout — AudioUIKitControls
plannedActions: Open the target screen at narrow and wide workspace sizes
Change zoom and inspect visible controls, scroll content and typography
expectedOutcomes: Required controls remain reachable without unintended clipping or overlap
Layout and text sizing follow the selected width and zoom while keeping content readable

scenarios.title: Edit duration and authored word timing — AudioUIKitControls
plannedActions: Open a timing editor for a known synthetic line or cue
Apply valid timing, try an invalid overlap or stale source, and reopen
expectedOutcomes: Accepted timing matches exact expected milliseconds and leaves neighbors unchanged
Invalid or stale edits preserve saved timing and show a bounded validation notice

scenarios.title: Import audio and edit its attachment — AudioUIKitControls
plannedActions: Import a bounded synthetic audio fixture and inspect its waveform
Trim its source and move its entry or scene attachment, then save/reopen
expectedOutcomes: Waveform, source bounds and placement reflect the stored clip
Only the intended audio fields change and missing or stale input is refused

scenarios.title: Inspect image provenance and source placement — ImageInspectorControllers
plannedActions: Open a stored image version and inspect prompt, tags and source cue
Navigate versions and sharing controls using a synthetic fixture
expectedOutcomes: Displayed provenance belongs to the selected immutable version
Editable tags or placement do not overwrite captured generation information

scenarios.title: Navigate registered app surfaces — ImageInspectorControllers
plannedActions: Open project, script, storyboard and account routes from visible controls
Present and dismiss nested screens while changing the active tab
expectedOutcomes: Each route presents its intended controller and current workspace state
Dismissal returns to the correct parent without losing selection

scenarios.title: Pair a bounded runtime companion session — RuntimeBootstrapXPC
plannedActions: Connect a synthetic authorized client to the bootstrap service
Attempt replay, wrong peer identity and a second-session ownership conflict
expectedOutcomes: Only the intended signed peer obtains its session pairing response
Replay or ownership mismatch cannot gain access to another session

scenarios.title: Preview and commit a picture split — ImageSplitPreviewController
plannedActions: Select a synthetic picture cue and preview an interior time split
Confirm the split, inspect both placements and undo/reopen
expectedOutcomes: Both placements preserve image and source anchoring while partitioning the intended interval
Cancel or invalid split leaves the original cue unchanged

scenarios.title: Navigate registered app surfaces — ScrivUIKitRouter
plannedActions: Open project, script, storyboard and account routes from visible controls
Present and dismiss nested screens while changing the active tab
expectedOutcomes: Each route presents its intended controller and current workspace state
Dismissal returns to the correct parent without losing selection

scenarios.title: Capture bounded provenance-linked evidence — ScrivCLICoverage
plannedActions: Run an owned synthetic CLI scenario with explicit evidence collection
Validate profile or source-manifest bounds, hashes and provenance before comparing results
expectedOutcomes: Evidence refers to the exact selected executable/source and owned run
Malformed, oversized or mismatched evidence fails without fabricating coverage

scenarios.title: Discover and execute owned CLI scenarios — package
plannedActions: List valid scenarios through Tracer and select a bounded fixture group
Check preflight evidence, child status and cleanup after success or failure
expectedOutcomes: Only known scenarios run with correct provenance and isolated state
Missing prerequisites fail clearly and owned temporary work is cleaned

scenarios.title: Place nonoverlapping cues into timeline lanes — ImagePresentationState
plannedActions: Open a synthetic timeline with overlapping and disjoint image cues
Inspect lane placement after moving a cue and changing zoom
expectedOutcomes: Overlapping cues occupy separate lanes while disjoint cues can share space
Visible ordering and cue identities remain consistent with saved intervals

scenarios.title: Sign in, inspect sessions and revoke access — email
plannedActions: Request and verify a synthetic sign-in challenge
Read current identity, revoke a session and retry its protected request
expectedOutcomes: A valid one-time proof establishes the intended identity
Incorrect, replayed and revoked proofs cannot authenticate

scenarios.title: Coordinate durable edits and live collaborators — notifications
plannedActions: Create two synthetic collaborators and edit a shared project
Retry an edit, introduce a version conflict, reconnect and revoke access
expectedOutcomes: The accepted revision and receipt survive retry without duplicate content
Peers converge on the journal and invalidated clients lose write or socket access

scenarios.title: Recover one staged generation before shared acceptance
plannedActions: In the original cloud-linked project, stage one completed synthetic output already imported locally; interrupt before canonical cloud acceptance. Explicitly recover twice, then separately explicitly retry a failed job. Repeat recovery with a lost or transferred claim.
expectedOutcomes: Recovery does not launch another model turn or import a second image. Shared completion waits for canonical image acceptance and a live owned claim; a lost claim blocks attachment or is explicitly reclaimed. Explicit retry is a distinct model run.

scenarios.title: Reject a symbolic-link package copy
plannedActions: Copy a valid symlink-free package into an isolated destination; repeat with any symlink in the source package, and separately try oversized or escaping member reads.
expectedOutcomes: A valid package can be copied; a source containing a symbolic link is rejected with no destination copy. Oversized or escaping reads are rejected, subject to the specific read path exercised.

scenarios.title: Inspect project-opening failure descriptions
plannedActions: Induce access, recovery and read failures using controlled non-sensitive long error domains, codes and localized descriptions, including an underlying NSError and synthetic marker; separately send CancellationError.
expectedOutcomes: Stage labels and raw domain/code and localized descriptions are shown as implemented, including the underlying error domain/code when present. No length bound or redaction is promised. Cancellation passes through unchanged.

scenarios.title: List suffix-matching project entries
plannedActions: List an isolated root containing a .scriv directory, a .scriv regular file and unrelated entries, then separately attempt to open the entries.
expectedOutcomes: Listing includes both suffix-matching entries regardless of package validity; validity is checked separately during opening.

scenarios.title: Recover persisted generation journal state
plannedActions: In a proposed CLI recovery fixture, persist a queued job and a completed job, close and reopen the project, and inspect their journal records without submitting work.
Invoke restart recovery and separately exercise repeated completed-output attachment at the workspace recovery handler.
expectedOutcomes: Reload preserves the completed record; queued or running work becomes waiting and is not automatically resubmitted.
Duplicate attachment suppression is checked at the workspace handler, not inferred from journal serialization.

scenarios.title: Open a cloud project with and without a matching replica
plannedActions: Open a known cloud project with a local package whose project ID, account and server checkpoint match. Repeat with only a mismatched account or server checkpoint.
expectedOutcomes: The matching package is reused with the attached snapshot; the mismatched checkpoint is not reused and a new local baseline is installed before the attached snapshot.

scenarios.title: Read absent and saved cloud checkpoints
plannedActions: In an isolated project read the checkpoint before it exists, then save a bounded synthetic checkpoint and read it back.
expectedOutcomes: The missing checkpoint is absent; the saved checkpoint round-trips its encoded fields.

scenarios.title: Share linked and local-only projects
plannedActions: In an isolated account share an already cloud-linked package with an identified team; separately share a local-only project. Compare IDs and original package data.
expectedOutcomes: The linked project creates and durably saves a new team copy before sync while retaining the original. The local-only project follows direct team sync rather than a mandatory copy.

scenarios.title: Compare known SHA-256 vectors
plannedActions: Using a proposed public CLI fixture digest observation route, hash empty bytes and a known multi-block vector, comparing lowercase hex against independently published SHA-256 values; when both are reachable compare portable and CryptoKit backends.
expectedOutcomes: Each digest equals the independent expected value, and reachable backends agree.
No context-menu or interaction behavior follows from this digest helper; a public observation route is needed rather than a new implementation-only suite.

scenarios.title: Reject an obsolete discussion response
plannedActions: Hold a controlled discussion response for thread A, select thread B and complete B first, then release A. Repeat for member and mention-history requests if their public routes are available.
expectedOutcomes: The stale A discussion response does not replace the current thread B results; other request generations need their own witnessed cases.

scenarios.title: Create and copy a team invitation
plannedActions: Create a join link for a specified team with a known service response; inspect the displayed last link and clipboard. Repeat with a failed response.
expectedOutcomes: A successful response records and copies its URL; failure is surfaced. No selected-team fence or out-of-order protection is assumed.

scenarios.title: Confirm and correct exact character links
plannedActions: In an owned synthetic line with two named occurrences and two characters, open Review character links, explicitly confirm one suggestion and correct or unlink the other exact occurrence, then save. Separately change the line or links while the sheet is open and try saving.
expectedOutcomes: The intended occurrence links change with source text unchanged. Changed text or saved links make the stale review refuse to overwrite the newer data.

scenarios.title: Block export when project durability fails
plannedActions: Prepare an isolated project for export, first with a matching saved snapshot, then with an injected disk mismatch or unresolved pending recovery before durability verification.
expectedOutcomes: A matching durable source permits export preparation; a mismatch or pending recovery blocks continuation and surfaces the failure.

scenarios.title: Resolve valid and invalid local image paths
plannedActions: Import a known small image in a disposable package and inspect it, then load fixtures referencing a missing image and an escaping or invalid path.
expectedOutcomes: The valid regular confined image resolves; invalid or missing paths yield no usable local asset URL.

scenarios.title: Switch scene and inspect playback presentation
plannedActions: Create two scenes with distinct audio or prompt content, select each scene and tab, then play, pause and seek through the public controls.
expectedOutcomes: The selected scene and playhead reflect those actions and the visible audio or prompt presentation updates for the current scene. Private invalidation itself is not assumed.

scenarios.title: Fence catalog mutation and script insertion by readiness
plannedActions: In an owned CLI session attempt a character catalog mutation on the characters tab with no modal or active draft, then with an active draft or stale context. On the script tab attempt insertion into the selected active matching editor, then a foreign editor or pending boundary.
expectedOutcomes: Ready catalog mutation and owned insertion proceed through their real public delegates. Ineligible states are refused without finishing, saving or discarding the active draft; the helper itself only returns readiness.

scenarios.title: Check recipient-scoped signaling inboxes
plannedActions: Connect three authenticated synthetic devices A, B and C to an eligible local project. Send an offer from A to B, poll as B, poll C's own inbox, and as C request B's deviceId explicitly.
Use separate cases to advance beyond the 120-second signal lifetime and revoke the recipient session, then repeat the relevant requests.
expectedOutcomes: B can retrieve the offer before expiry. C's own inbox contains no B offer, and a request by C naming B's deviceId is rejected. Expired offers are omitted; revoked-session access is refused by authentication/access guards.

scenarios.title: Exercise distinct CLI front-door routes
plannedActions: In a prepared disposable CLI build, send capabilities and snapshot, then a nonsensitive control activation and one specialized route such as export-fountain; record response IDs and UI/persisted state.

Send malformed JSON, overlap a valid asynchronous image import with a second command while the first is demonstrably pending, and send an over-1,048,576-byte line followed by a valid command. Inspect snapshot redaction with a synthetic sensitive text field.
expectedOutcomes: Capabilities and selected routes report their actual corresponding result; snapshot suppresses sensitive field contents.

Malformed JSON produces an error response and the pending overlap produces the busy error; the oversized line is skipped without a response, while a later valid command remains processable. These are separate focused witnesses, not blanket coverage of the entire adapter.

scenarios.title: Distinguish upload and download integrity
plannedActions: In a future owned CLI cloud-client journey against an approved local synthetic service, open a project and upload bytes with the correct SHA-256 and deliberately wrong asset.byteCount, then upload altered bytes against the original digest. Download matching bytes, bytes of the wrong length, and same-length bytes with a wrong digest.
expectedOutcomes: The client sends the digest-valid upload despite the wrong metadata byteCount; the service may independently reject it. The wrong-digest upload is rejected before PUT. Download returns the matching bytes and rejects either count or digest mismatch.

scenarios.title: Check verifier encoding without claiming Keychain execution
plannedActions: Extend an isolated public sign-in CLI fixture with a test-only deterministic randomness source returning exactly 32 bytes: fb ff followed by 30 zero bytes. Preserve production length and random generation outside this synthetic fixture. Capture the PKCE encoding; separately exercise sign-in, read and sign-out through the CLI memory credential backend. Inspect real KeychainToken statically rather than claiming the memory backend executes Security APIs.
expectedOutcomes: The 32-byte synthetic input encodes as -_8AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA, a 43-character unpadded base64url value with + and / replaced. Production still generates exactly 32 random bytes. The memory-backend journey covers its caller behavior, not execution of KeychainToken Security APIs.

scenarios.title: Observe a verified local fixture image
plannedActions: Stage a private non-cloud package with one allowlisted 73-byte 2×2 PNG, no generation jobs and a visible workspace or exact inspector preview; call local-image-evidence.
Repeat with nonfixture bytes/hash and an out-of-scope active context.
expectedOutcomes: The returned asset ID, digest, byte count, dimensions and visible preview correspond to that fixture on the verified surface.
The nonfixture and out-of-scope cases fail rather than returning image evidence.

scenarios.title: Change playback volume and restore mute
plannedActions: Play a fixture with audio, set a nonzero volume, mute and unmute, and inspect the playback controls and audible or exposed volume state.
expectedOutcomes: Mute lowers the effective volume and unmute restores the previous nonzero volume; import and placement are separate behaviors.

scenarios.title: Read team and send exact membership requests
plannedActions: In a future owned CLI client journey against an approved local synthetic service, open team T, read team details, revoke existing link L, change user U role to admin, and remove U. Record requests, then explicitly refresh team details.
expectedOutcomes: GET uses T; DELETE targets T/join-links/L; PATCH targets T/members/U with role admin; DELETE targets T/members/U. Mutations discard JSON responses; membership is observed only through the later GET.

scenarios.title: Plan pending project recovery separately from replay
plannedActions: Create ordered synthetic pending-save records in an owned project, with one already saved canonical/history revision and later contiguous revisions, then request recovery planning; repeat with a conflicting source and corrupt record. If actual recovery is separately exercised, save each replay entry via ProjectRepository before acknowledging it.
expectedOutcomes: The plan returns ordered replay and alreadySaved lists without itself writing the package or acknowledging records. Conflict or corruption retains records; only an explicit successful durable save permits its exact acknowledgement.

scenarios.title: Review matching and interrupted image analysis
plannedActions: In a proposed isolated native CLI fixture with an explicitly injected local synthetic provider, queue a valid result for a digest-verified image and observe its review item.

In separate runs delay the provider while switching project/navigation or image version, and inject an interruption classified as unexpected tool activity; inspect paused state and invoke Scan again explicitly.
expectedOutcomes: Only the still-matching project, navigation and image version receives the valid result; stale results are not applied.

The uncertain turn pauses without automatic replay until explicit Scan again. Current verification mode disables this provider, so a scoped fixture extension is needed; this plan does not represent provider execution.

scenarios.title: Route project, invitation and billing URLs
plannedActions: Deliver an isolated .scriv package URL, a controlled valid team join URL and an eligible billing callback; then send malformed and ineligible billing callbacks.
expectedOutcomes: The valid URLs invoke their respective open, join or account-refresh paths. Ineligible billing callbacks do not trigger refresh; no generic error is assumed.

scenarios.title: Open timing from idle Layers then observe
plannedActions: Extend journeys/word-timing with its three-word 3000 ms fixture: prepared local idle workspace, expanded Layers, no modal and unique word label. Send menu-action target that word, action Edit word timing….

Only after dispatch observe the direct timing form sheet with current scene/navigation/window. Repeat dispatch while the editor is open and refuse it. Cloud-connected/stale/wrong-window/nonunique-label cases use planned public fixtures or explicit static guards.
expectedOutcomes: Valid initial call returns dispatched:true and coverage semantic-menu-action and opens the real sheet; it does not prove native menu/hardware input.
An already-presented modal blocks dispatch, while editor observation requires that owned sheet. Ineligible contexts are refused; unavailable negative controls remain unexecuted.

scenarios.title: Render valid peer selection backgrounds
plannedActions: Plan public local collaboration/UI fixture text A😀B with a synthetic peer selecting UTF-16 offsets 1..3. Render the real Script display with no playback-word/character-link highlight, then clear peer selection through collaboration input.

Statically check empty 1..1, reversed 3..1, negative, end>4 and broken-surrogate 2..3 cases against ScriptAttributedText.make and its real row caller. If transport rejects malformed values first, do not claim dynamic helper coverage or bypass it with a unit suite.
expectedOutcomes: Valid 1..3 contributes accent background only to the emoji range; clearing removes the peer contribution when rerendered.
Static guards require nonnegative increasing bounds, end within UTF-16 count and successful Range conversion. No receipts, durable revisions, journal convergence or revocation claim belongs here.

scenarios.title: Display stored discussion anchor labels
plannedActions: Create a synthetic project containing project-level, dialogue, direction, character, cue, image and missing-item discussion anchors; open their existing discussion/attachment presentations through a proposed CLI-visible fixture.
For an attachment containing both imageVersionId and itemId, choose distinct assets and inspect the displayed version and corresponding symbols.
Repeat with imageVersionId naming a missing asset and itemId naming an existing asset, then inspect that no fallback image is selected.
expectedOutcomes: Project, line/direction, character, cue, image and archived-item labels follow their stored IDs; image label includes its version.
Explicit imageVersionId takes precedence over itemId, including a missing explicit version rather than fallback; mutation of threads belongs to the controller/service.

scenarios.title: Separate checkout and billing portal flows
plannedActions: In a controlled eligible-owner Teams UI fixture, choose subscription checkout and test Cancel and Open checkout in separate runs.
Choose Manage billing separately, then repeat while team/account context changes or browser opening is denied.
expectedOutcomes: Cancel does not open checkout; confirmation requests the intended checkout destination.
Manage billing directly requests the portal without the checkout confirmation; stale context or denied opening follows its actual error/no-open path.

scenarios.title: Round-trip distinct CloudUser records
plannedActions: Plan a public CLI fixture endpoint that returns and re-encodes two synthetic CloudUser records: different IDs/names, one with email and avatar URL and one with both omitted. Capture both encoded responses and decoded fields.
expectedOutcomes: Each returned record retains its own ID, name and optional fields through encode/decode; this requires a proposed public observation route and is not proved by merely signing in.

scenarios.title: Export a durable project package
plannedActions: Export a saved fixture containing image and audio to a disposable destination; compare package contents, then inject a durable-source or destination copy failure.
expectedOutcomes: The successful export contains the saved package and assets; an invalid durable source or failed copy surfaces an export failure rather than success.

scenarios.title: Inspect retained legacy AppKit workflow configuration
plannedActions: Read the retained workflow and resolve the named legacy commands against the published source without invoking any job, installer, build or test command.
expectedOutcomes: Retained Mac job references removed Swift tests and build-mac.sh plus retired AppKit peer-smoke/screenshots and artifact paths. It does not configure the current Catalyst packaging gate.
Verify exact preservation of remote workflow blob 908b38e3e9e8c8dfec01a612731673532db2b4c7 without changing or executing it.

scenarios.title: Rename local and cloud-linked projects
plannedActions: Rename a local project using surrounding whitespace, reopen it, try a blank name, and rename a linked fixture while recording the controlled service request.
expectedOutcomes: The local title is trimmed and persisted, blank input is ignored, and the linked project requests the corresponding cloud rename.

scenarios.title: Select a character and assign a speaker separately
plannedActions: Select a known character, inspect the active tab and selection, then explicitly assign that character to one dialogue entry and compare another entry.
expectedOutcomes: Selection opens the characters tab and selects the character; only the separate assignment changes the target speaker, leaving the other entry unchanged.

scenarios.title: Update peer carets and measured layout
plannedActions: Plan public collaboration/UI journey for peer Ada and text A😀B: endpoint 3, endpoint 4, changed name, then empty peer list. Inspect real Script marker labels and placement after each update.

Use planned guarded workspace resize to change measured width by >0.5 points. Statically inspect negative/out-of-bounds/broken-surrogate endpoint 2, width<=1 and nonfinite caret geometry, rather than directly constructing private views.
expectedOutcomes: Valid endpoint renders a noninteractive marker labelled Ada is editing here and its name; signature changes remove old markers before rebuilding, and empty peers remove them.

Invalid UTF-16 endpoints/nonfinite geometry are skipped. Width change >0.5 invalidates intrinsic size and calls sizeChanged; intrinsic height is at least font line height+3. Runtime layout remains unverified.

scenarios.title: Pause unconfirmed character analysis cancellation
plannedActions: Using a planned owned CLI review journey with an isolated synthetic JSON-RPC app-server fixture that drives the production CodexController, analyze verified fixture bytes, separately tamper with them before submission and after the submitted turn before final response, and cancel after capturing thread and turn IDs while the fixture withholds final status or fails interrupt.
expectedOutcomes: Digest tampering is rejected; cancellation requests turn/interrupt with the captured thread and turn. An unconfirmed remote result pauses for review, not proof the remote turn stopped; synthetic provider execution is not actual Codex execution.

scenarios.title: Manually tag one image
plannedActions: On two known images manually choose character IDs for the first image, save and reopen the project, then inspect both images.
expectedOutcomes: The first image has the chosen manual tags and the second image remains unchanged; no provider analysis is required.

scenarios.title: Check billing authorization and fixed price
plannedActions: Run a local mocked Stripe journey with owner, nonowner and revoked actors. Request checkout and portal separately: check the fixed USD 9.99 monthly licensed price for checkout, allowed Stripe destination for each route, and current provider reconciliation before new checkout.

Submit an accepted valid signed webhook and retry the same event with access refresh succeeding. Separately fail access refresh on a duplicate and then permit a later retry. Inspect HTTP responses, event rows, provider calls and refresh attempts; also send an invalid signature. Exercise scheduled reconciliation and billing return-page behavior as separate cases.
expectedOutcomes: Eligible checkout verifies the configured fixed price and uses the allowed checkout Stripe destination; eligible portal uses its allowed billing Stripe destination without checking the checkout price. Nonowner and revoked actors are refused.

Current provider state is reconciled before new checkout. A duplicate accepted event does not add another event row or reapply an obsolete provider snapshot; it retries access refresh. Successful refresh returns received=true; failed refresh produces retryable HTTP 502, and a later successful retry can acknowledge. Invalid signatures fail. No live payment or real provider execution is implied.

scenarios.title: Finish coverage before terminating a session
plannedActions: Close an owned coverage-observed CLI session while recording collector and process events; repeat with a forced finish failure.
expectedOutcomes: A coverage finish is attempted before termination. The owned process still terminates on finish failure and that failure is not described as a successful profile.

scenarios.title: Request restricted scenario through the runner
plannedActions: Use a disposable repository and the public CLI runner to request the declared blocked scenario by exact ID; inspect emitted not-run evidence and recorded reason, and independently observe that no scenario/app process was launched.
Compare catalog lookup and a permitted scenario request in a separately eligible synthetic runner fixture; keep unrelated platform/app preflight failures distinct from this restriction.
expectedOutcomes: The declared blocked scenario remains not-run with its recorded reason and is never spawned. An unlisted allowed scenario is not denied by this restriction entry, although ordinary runner preflight still applies.

scenarios.title: Check isolated run capability boundaries
plannedActions: Start a disposable private isolated run and inspect capabilities; attempt loopback and foreign network requests through a proposed public CLI fixture route, and independently exercise scoped outbox writes/reads and in-memory credentials in separate runs.

Use a compiler/static inspection of validateLoopbackOrigin with canonical http://127.0.0.1:1234 and invalid hostname, credentials, path or port variants; stage an unsafe root, overlarge record and excessive outbox entries for public preflight checks.
expectedOutcomes: Current prepared runs report network disabled and reject both loopback and foreign requests; syntax acceptance of loopback is not a network grant.

Outbox operations stay in their validated scope and rejected bounds/root cases fail; credentials do not persist across process runs. Fixture routes for currently inaccessible operations must be explicitly added before execution.

scenarios.title: Restore as owner and paid administrator
plannedActions: Extend tracer app -- test services collaboration with independent fresh paid owner/admin/member/viewer fixtures and two known revisions. POST restore to revision1 using new commandId and actor session/current epoch; observe restored content, epoch and leases.

Run denial cases with unused IDs for member, viewer and lapsed admin in read grace. Do not reuse a cached successful restore ID as permission evidence because cached receipt lookup precedes authorization gate.
expectedOutcomes: Owner and paid admin both restore when canManage&&canWrite, advance epoch and clear leases.
Nonmanager or read-only actor receives not_allowed for a fresh restore and preserves content/epoch. The source does not reject all nonowners; old-epoch edit rejection belongs to the commands handler.

scenarios.title: Explicitly retry a pending cloud sync
plannedActions: Make a local edit in an isolated linked project, arrange a sync failure or disconnection, restore the connection and explicitly invoke retry.
expectedOutcomes: Retry invokes synchronization for the active project and the edited content is retained; a service acknowledgment is required before claiming remote acceptance.

scenarios.title: Replay a claim after completion
plannedActions: Extend tracer app -- test services generation using its isolated loopback worker, paid synthetic member and two device sessions. Create version-1 job, claim with operation C/expectedVersion 1, then complete with new operation/expectedVersion 2 and outputImageId.

Replay exact C on the original live device after completion; then change its payload, replay from the second device, and attempt a fresh recovery claim on the completed job. Use separate recovered-running fixtures, each with a fresh operation ID having no prior receipt, for a stale expected version and former-device completion/progress write; inspect refusals. In another queued/running/waiting fixture, submit cancellation from a live session belonging to the same creator using the current version and write access.
expectedOutcomes: Exact old claim returns replayed:true with current completed version 3 and outputImageId, not a running version-2 grant.

Changed request/device reuse yields operation_conflict. With a fresh operation ID and no prior receipt, a claim on a completed job, stale version, or non-cancellation update by the former device yields job_conflict without overwrite. Exact earlier update replays are handled before the ownership gate and can return current state. The same creator may cancel a queued/running/waiting job from another live session when expected version and write access match; cancellation is an explicit exception. Replay requires current write access and live matching session; no provider runs.

scenarios.title: Relaunch a live persistent session before closing
plannedActions: Launch an owned persistent session, settle all commands, relaunch while live and inspect persisted state, then close. Attempt relaunch after close and separately wait for an unmet condition.
expectedOutcomes: Live settled relaunch preserves the intended workspace, post-close relaunch is refused, and an unmet wait times out.

scenarios.title: Render updater phases and one-shot choices
plannedActions: In a proposed CLI-visible native updater event fixture, deliver available, downloading with progress, ready and error phases; inspect labels and buttons.
Choose install, cancel or close, repeat the event/callback, and press Escape in both guarded and allowed phases.
expectedOutcomes: Displayed text and controls follow the event phase; callback choices are one-shot and Escape acts only when its guard allows it.
This controller does not validate packages or signatures; those require a separate real-updater scenario.

scenarios.title: Exercise email challenge UI state
plannedActions: With a proposed controlled local challenge fixture, enter a whitespace-padded mixed-case email, request a code and return a valid challenge with bounded expiry/resend times; enter a six-digit code to begin verification.
Repeat with malformed email/code or challenge, expired challenge, resend within cooldown, a delayed stale operation response after cancel, and explicit cancellation.
expectedOutcomes: Email/code normalization and requesting, awaiting-code and verifying states follow the fixture; malformed, expired, cooldown and stale operations are rejected or ignored as applicable.
Cancel resets the UI state. Proof authentication, replay prevention and revocation belong to separate service/client cases; the fixture does not send real email.

scenarios.title: Reject unexpected and stale character-analysis events
plannedActions: Use a controlled synthetic analysis turn with a matching valid completion. In a separate turn inject unexpected tool activity before a valid completion. In another turn inject an unrelated thread/turn event, then deliver a matching valid completion.
expectedOutcomes: A matching completed uncancelled valid turn exposes final text. Unexpected tool activity sets failure and prevents final text. Unrelated thread/turn events are ignored and do not themselves suppress a later matching valid completion; retry belongs to the controller.

scenarios.title: Check update coordinator presentation fences
plannedActions: Plan public CLI Check for Updates in isolated bundles with absent/invalid public key and separately a 32-byte key with missing plugin; reopen while visible and inspect the single-sheet state.

With a planned inert local plugin that performs no download, install or relaunch, forward representative plugin events and request prepare(false)/prepare(true) for synthetic workspaces; inject failed saves, no workspace, concurrent preparation and dismissal.
expectedOutcomes: Missing/invalid key or plugin displays the corresponding issue and repeated show focuses the existing sheet; plugin phases are forwarded.

Preparation requires successful saves of all workspaces; concurrent or absent-workspace preparation fails. Relaunch handoff requires its available sheet and a second successful save after dismissal. Package signature and install validation are outside this coordinator.

scenarios.title: Open the general character review list
plannedActions: Run a controlled image scan with an unresolved item, activate the scan banner, inspect the general review list and then select the item.
expectedOutcomes: The banner opens the general review list containing the unresolved item; selecting it is a separate action, not a direct banner jump.

scenarios.title: Compare verification-mode startup recovery
plannedActions: Launch disposable Catalyst fixtures with and without the screenshot or peer-smoke verification flag and a known pending recovery record, where a safe public route permits it.
expectedOutcomes: Verification mode takes its startup recovery skip path; an ordinary launch may inventory or recover pending work. The ordinary launch route remains a feasibility gap if unavailable to CLI.

scenarios.title: Validate cue field shapes
plannedActions: Through the local service CLI journey submit a valid cue with paired anchor and duration, then submit one missing either pair member, an invalid scene ID string, and negative/out-of-bounds numeric fields.
expectedOutcomes: Valid syntactic fields pass this validator; malformed IDs, unpaired fields and invalid numeric bounds fail.
Whether the referenced scene exists or the cue fits its duration is assessed separately in project-room validation.

scenarios.title: Repeat attachment recovery in its original project
plannedActions: For a completed synthetic generation, request attachment or recovery twice in its original project, then repeat after a project or claim change.
expectedOutcomes: Repeated recovery must not create a duplicate immutable image; context or ownership mismatch prevents attaching the output to the wrong project.

scenarios.title: Route settings and observe scene lifecycle
plannedActions: Open a synthetic settings window and route a connection activity to its intended pane. Start a controlled pending connection check, disconnect that scene, and separately background a scene with a pending edit/save.
expectedOutcomes: The activity selects the intended window/pane; disconnect cancels the pending check.
Background ends editing and requests a save flush; no session destruction or complete cleanup is asserted.

scenarios.title: Test duration drag against stale state
plannedActions: On a disposable script line, hold and drag duration, then release after an acquired edit; separately deny acquisition, cancel the gesture, change navigation or source entry before release, and introduce a competing lock.
expectedOutcomes: A live valid drag previews and can commit once; the denied, cancelled, stale or competing-lock cases do not apply that draft.
The driver caches acquisition and does not revalidate lease expiry at commit, so expiry alone must not be claimed to prevent mutation.

scenarios.title: Discover and validate a missing peer image
plannedActions: In a permitted peer-enabled isolated setup, request a known missing image, offer matching bytes from an authorized peer, then repeat with corrupted bytes or an unauthorized hash. Also run a transport-disabled fixture.
expectedOutcomes: Verified bytes can install for the known image; corrupted or unauthorized replicas do not install. A disabled transport reports its disabled state, not successful discovery.

scenarios.title: Distinguish import replay from new import
plannedActions: Extend public collaboration service journey: empty project, import one synthetic scene with command C/session/epoch1, retain receipt and snapshot. Repeat identical body and actor with C, then identical items with fresh D, then C with changed label/body.
Maintain normal authenticated access and inspect snapshot head/items after each request so an access error cannot masquerade as replay behavior.
expectedOutcomes: Exact C returns original receipt without another event/item despite the populated room.
New D fails project_not_empty and changed C fails command_reused; accepted content/head stay unchanged. Not every second import HTTP request is rejected.

scenarios.title: Check panel stacking at workspace widths
plannedActions: At positive widths below, at and above 860, inspect Script, Characters and Storyboard with discussion open and closed; record layout and footer.
expectedOutcomes: The layout follows the actual tab/discussion/width stacking predicate, panel ratio and always-on footer. Zoom and typography are outside this span.

scenarios.title: Compare foreground presenter with store-scoped finish editing
plannedActions: In a planned owned two-window CLI journey, put an active editor in each workspace, present a navigation controller in the foreground window, and trigger nil-store finishEditing then a separate finishEditing for the background store.
expectedOutcomes: Presenter resolves the foreground key window and its top presented/navigation visible controller. Nil-store ending affects that foreground window; store-scoped finishing posts that store and ends matching workspace windows even if background, leaving the unrelated editor alone.

scenarios.title: Clamp and restore workspace zoom
plannedActions: Set zoom below, within and above the supported range, including a value requiring two-decimal rounding; safely try non-finite input if the route permits it and relaunch the persistent workspace.
expectedOutcomes: Zoom is clamped to 0.7–2.0, rounded to two decimals, rejects non-finite values, and a saved valid preference is restored.

scenarios.title: Drag real word timeline endpoints
plannedActions: Extend public word-timing journey with planned guarded pointer input on the actual Manual word timing overview: 3000 ms line, word 1000..2000, bounds observed so x(t)=8+(width-16)*t/3000. Tap bar at y20, pan within18 points of start to x500; fresh draft pan end to x2500.
Observe selected word, fields/bar/accessibility value; cancel. Try y outside10..44, pan farther than18 points from both handles, and movement outside timeline. Do not directly call view callbacks.
expectedOutcomes: The two valid drags produce preview ranges 500..2000 and 1000..2500; bar tap selects its word.

Start clamps 0..end-1 and end clamps start+1..duration; far handle pan is refused and off-band tap selects nothing. Playhead draws only within 0..duration. Save/overlap/source validation stays with editor/draft.

scenarios.title: Release an old project response after switching
plannedActions: Delay a controlled synchronization operation for project A, switch to project B and complete B, then release the old A response.
expectedOutcomes: The stale A operation does not populate B’s workspace or synchronization state; cancellation does not imply a remote request was undone.

scenarios.title: Open a listed project and surface a bad package
plannedActions: List an isolated root, open a known valid package, then attempt to open an inaccessible or corrupt isolated .scriv package.
expectedOutcomes: The valid project opens; the bad package reports an opening error rather than being represented as a successful open.

scenarios.title: Inspect character analysis request protocol
plannedActions: Use a proposed isolated CLI fixture to capture a synthetic analysis request and response: compare model, read-only sandbox, network=false, approval=never, cwd and ephemeral thread ID; inspect bounded prompt and output schema.
Return a valid detection JSON, then a malformed/out-of-range region and an oversized response in separate cases.
expectedOutcomes: The exact requested thread settings are checked before an image is sent; valid result decodes and invalid region or excessive response is rejected.
Unexpected tool event and retry decisions belong to the turn-state/controller; verification mode currently disables analysis and requires an explicit synthetic fixture extension.

scenarios.title: Specify Unicode and empty word fixtures
plannedActions: Submit valid synthetic dialogue entries through the isolated local service with independently specified native-aligned word arrays for punctuation, Unicode graphemes, whitespace-only text and the empty string. Keep all other timing fields valid.
For the empty-text entry repeat with one spurious word timing, and for a nonempty fixture submit a deliberately mismatched word list.
expectedOutcomes: Field validation accepts the independently specified native-aligned word arrays, including an empty array for empty/whitespace-only text; spurious or mismatched words are rejected. No native runtime execution is inferred.

scenarios.title: Collect profiles around tabs one then zero
plannedActions: Plan node scripts/probe-cli-coverage.mjs --app <matching automation-and-coverage bundle> --output <new private directory>. Capture before, select workspace-tabs index 1 then 0 exactly once with readiness observations, and capture after.

Independently hash each output file and compare executable before/after hashes; keep cumulative snapshots separate. Statically inspect existing-output and executable-change failure branches without manufacturing app responses.
expectedOutcomes: The manifest records workspace-tabs-1-then-0, two bounded nonempty profiles with matching digests, and equal executable hashes on successful collection.

applicationSourceSHA256 remains null; probeSourceSHA256 identifies the collector only. attribution is observed-during-sequence-not-causal, cumulative:true and counterReset:false. Failed collection is not completed coverage.

scenarios.title: Protect a cue draft across scope and revision changes
plannedActions: Retain a cue direction draft in an owned project; replace it with a newer revision and try an older clear. Attempt applying the retained draft using a different account, project or cue scope, then rebase only after an explicit source change review.
expectedOutcomes: Stale clear does not remove the newer revision; wrong-scope apply is rejected and leaves the original draft and project unchanged. Rebase retains pending text while changing its reviewed base.

scenarios.title: List eligible media devices
plannedActions: Using an isolated service fixture query devices with own live sessions, premium team-member sessions, revoked or expired sessions and an unrelated user. Include a device also used in another project.
expectedOutcomes: Own live sessions and eligible premium teammate sessions are returned, revoked/expired and unrelated sessions are excluded, and onlineStatus remains unknown. Use of another project alone is not an exclusion.

scenarios.title: Prepare sample content in an isolated workspace
plannedActions: Identify the public verification caller and launch it only with a disposable CLI workspace, invoke sample preparation, and inspect its selected example, bundled images and cues.
expectedOutcomes: The selected sample and its bundled image/cue content are installed in that workspace. Isolation is established by the caller and setup, not by an assumed guard in the preparation method.

scenarios.title: Build and capture instrumented CLI coverage
plannedActions: Use the Tracer build journey to check valid and invalid instrumentation flags and the real instrumented CLI to capture and release a bounded profile; also inspect the ordinary-build guard.
expectedOutcomes: The instrumented interface and build guard behave as declared, and a real bounded capture is observable. No independent stub-based implementation unit suite is introduced.

scenarios.title: Reset rate admission at the next time bucket
plannedActions: With a controlled clock send requests through the limit, exceed it, then advance to the next bucket boundary while the previous database row remains unexpired.
expectedOutcomes: Requests over the limit are rejected within a bucket and a new bucket admits requests at its boundary; expires_at is cleanup retention, not the reset time.

scenarios.title: Create, join and invite to teams
plannedActions: Using controlled local service fixtures create a team, join a specified team with a valid invitation, create and copy that team’s join link, then submit an invalid invitation.
expectedOutcomes: The successful operations produce their corresponding team or link effects; invalid invitation input is reported as an error.

scenarios.title: Select an entry with its source-anchored cue
plannedActions: Create a scene with a zero-duration direction and dialogue sharing a timestamp, with a known source-anchored cue; select the intended entry.
expectedOutcomes: Scene, entry, playhead and selected cue correspond to the selected entry and its source cue rather than an unrelated cue at the same time.

scenarios.title: Inspect blank and example constructors
plannedActions: Extend public projects/project-roundtrip journey: inspect startup YAM MAN through loaded-project, then create a blank project through browser New project and inspect before other lifecycle edits. Allow generated IDs/dates in blank.
Compare example stable IDs and literal timing tables; statically inspect all18 entry definitions and19 cue labels. Do not credit browser search/cancel/delete to this constructor.
expectedOutcomes: Blank has INT. LOCATION — DAY, direction Describe the opening moment. at order0/owned0/coverage3000, dialogue Your first line. at order1, cue01A0..3000.

Example has scene-farm, character-randy/character-miyazaki/character-franklin, line-01..line-16 plus direction-08/direction-10,19 fixed cue IDs, and source-table word IDs/timings for line-08/line-10. Persistence is separate.

scenarios.title: Request a known image from a peer
plannedActions: With an active cloud workspace and authorized peer transport, request a missing known-hash image, inspect received status and bytes, then try an unauthorized or failed transfer.
expectedOutcomes: A verified known replica can be received by the workspace bridge; unauthorized or failed transfer does not install an unverified image. Disabled transport is a separate outcome.

scenarios.title: Check Catalyst icon bundle resources
plannedActions: Run the icon verifier on isolated bundles with AppIcon metadata and Assets.car, varying an existing computed .icns file and a nonempty CFBundleIconFiles value independently. Include nonempty metadata referencing nonexistent icon files, missing Assets.car, invalid AppIcon metadata, and both final alternatives absent.
expectedOutcomes: Acceptance requires the specified AppIcon metadata, an existing Assets.car and either an existing computed .icns file or nonempty CFBundleIconFiles metadata. Metadata referencing nonexistent icon files can satisfy the latter alternative. Missing catalog, invalid AppIcon metadata or both alternatives absent fails. Icon contents, signing, version and installation are not verified.

scenarios.title: Navigate matching script entries
plannedActions: Create a synthetic scene with two distinct entries containing the same word, one containing it twice, and a character alias match. Search the word and alias; advance past the last and before the first, search an absent term, then clear.
expectedOutcomes: Each matching entry contributes one result regardless of occurrence count; next and previous wrap and scroll to the corresponding row. An absent query displays 0 results and clearing removes the count.

scenarios.title: Finish or merge at an eligible caret
plannedActions: Extend journeys/script-merge: focus the second compatible dialogue row, ensure editable/unmarked text and collapsed selection 0..0, send public delete-backward once and inspect merge counts/rows. In fresh fixtures delete a nonempty selection or at nonzero caret.

Send key Escape while editing and inspect finish/focus transition. Planned marked-composition/noneditable public routes remain extensions; statically inspect their fallthrough and missing-callback branch instead of directly invoking private callbacks.
expectedOutcomes: Only editable unmarked collapsed-zero selection with installed merge callback invokes mergeAtStart exactly once; other deletion follows super.deleteBackward without that callback.
Escape calls finishEditing. IME/noneditable static checks are not execution; this override alone does not prove persistence or scene invariants.

scenarios.title: Decline redirects and isolate authentication challenges
plannedActions: With a future approved isolated local transport fixture, request an endpoint returning same-origin and cross-origin redirects, inject session-level and task-level authentication challenges, and return a CloudRequestError with a known message through a public client journey.
expectedOutcomes: Neither redirect is followed. In isolated automation both challenge completion handlers cancel; the displayed/localized CloudRequestError description equals its supplied message. This is not a general transport privacy guarantee.

scenarios.title: Exercise supported account sign-in routes
plannedActions: Use a controlled email-code sign-in and sign-out; separately exercise a valid GitHub path only where the non-automation restriction permits it, and fail or cancel one request.
expectedOutcomes: Successful authentication updates identity and dismisses sign-in; sign-out clears account state, while failure is visible or cancellation ends without a success claim. GitHub feasibility is not assumed in CLI automation.

scenarios.title: Observe async operation error routing
plannedActions: Invoke reachable operations that succeed, fail with normal reporting, fail with peer-status reporting, and cancel. Observe the relevant status fields.
expectedOutcomes: Normal failures populate errorMessage, peer-reporting failures populate peerTransferStatus, and cancellation is not reported by this wrapper. No general state cleanup is attributed to it.

scenarios.title: Choose a project and restore its bookmark
plannedActions: In a planned isolated CLI picker journey choose a synthetic project package, edit/save and relaunch, then restore its bookmark; separately cancel selection, remove the bookmark, and provide corrupt bookmark bytes before attempting actual file I/O.
expectedOutcomes: Selection is retained and restored when valid; cancellation returns no URL. Missing bookmark returns the original URL, with access failure determined by later I/O; corrupt bookmark resolution fails rather than claiming every missing bookmark is an error.

scenarios.title: Browse package parent without replacing it
plannedActions: Plan planned public CLI-driven native Settings > Show package… for an owned saved synthetic package. Use a permitted future chooser observer/control route to inspect initial directory; cancel, reopen and choose a sibling synthetic folder/package inside the same owned parent.

Compare current project identity/URL and package bytes. Statically check projectURL.deletingLastPathComponent and ignored completion URL; do not imply the system picker itself lacks all file-management actions.
expectedOutcomes: Chooser starts at current package parent and allows folder/project types; missing projectURL opens nothing.
Cancel/ordinary choose does not replace or modify the project through this callback. Broader picker capabilities and current CLI chooser reachability remain unverified.

scenarios.title: Export and verify a source manifest
plannedActions: In a disposable isolated source tree export the CLI source manifest to a location outside the tree, and verify it against its pinned digest.
Independently alter eligible file contents, add/remove an eligible file, introduce a symlink, or supply a different manifest digest and rerun verification.

In the same isolated source fixture with private .tracer audit storage, request an export using --include .tracer; assert exit2 and no output manifest. Recheck the ordinary exact eligible source manifest without including private storage.
expectedOutcomes: An unchanged matching manifest verifies; altered content, eligible set, forbidden symlink or digest fails the relevant verification.
The base commit is producer-declared and the manifest does not attest to an executable or a running scenario.
Private .tracer storage is excluded from the valid eligible source set; explicitly requesting it is refused without creating the requested output.

scenarios.title: Preview and race a cloud history restore
plannedActions: Preview a known historical revision and confirm the current draft remains intact. Hold a restore response, edit locally, then let the restore complete.
expectedOutcomes: Preview does not replace the current project. After a concurrent local edit, cloud restore may already have completed; the newer local draft remains and a conflict is reported for reconciliation.

scenarios.title: Snapshot and activate an exact modal button
plannedActions: Open a synthetic own-process native modal with a visible enabled button and text/protected controls; issue native-accessibility-snapshot and record that button path and exact label.
Activate with native-accessibility-activate, then in separate fresh snapshots try a mismatched label, replaced modal, and reuse of the invalidated snapshot.

In a separate explicitly synthetic modal, provide a visible enabled public button whose accessibility press raises an exception. Take a fresh native-accessibility-snapshot of that modal, record the exact button path/label and ensure the public hit test resolves to the button. Activate that observed target once, then inspect the unknown-outcome response and invalidated snapshot without retrying.
expectedOutcomes: Text/protected labels are suppressed as represented by the snapshot and the exact current button can dispatch after rescan and hit test.
Changed modal, incorrect label and stale observed target do not dispatch; an exceptional press has unknown outcome and must not be retried automatically.

scenarios.title: Retime matched and short-duration words
plannedActions: Through a public CLI fixture that invokes the retiming path, edit synthetic text with retained, inserted and removed tokens at duration at least token count; inspect returned word IDs and ordered intervals.
Add a direct observable too-short duration case and an input where old-token count times new-token count exceeds 250,000 to reach the large-input matching path.
expectedOutcomes: Matched IDs persist and intervals are ordered within the effective duration; inserted tokens receive new IDs and removed tokens disappear.

For a requested duration shorter than token count, effective duration expands to token count, so the output may exceed the requested duration. A dedicated public observation extension may be required for that case.

scenarios.title: Inspect generated image artifact evidence
plannedActions: Prepare a disposable isolated generation job with recorded completed artifact, persisted project attachment and journal, and expose its loaded visible preview; call image-evidence.
Compare job, journal, asset identifiers, recorded digests, decoded dimensions and preview evidence; repeat with an unsafe path or digest-mismatched artifact and with an incomplete job.
expectedOutcomes: Matching completed records and visible preview identify the same image, hash and dimensions.
Unsafe or mismatched evidence is rejected; incomplete jobs are explicitly unverified rather than reported as completed. A synthetic provider/fixture is planned, not actual generation.

scenarios.title: Undo, redo and restore project history
plannedActions: Edit a known project, undo and redo the edit, then restore a chosen history snapshot; inject a restoration failure separately.
expectedOutcomes: Content follows each requested operation while project identity, cloud ID, revision and creation date are preserved by restoration; a failed restore reports an error.

scenarios.title: Authenticate and stop an owned runtime child
plannedActions: Start the companion with a private pairing directory; connect a loopback client without a valid signed envelope and send status, then use the pairing capability to send a signed Start with an allowed controlled codex executable and a private Generation root.
Exchange a valid message and poll its event, then stop or disconnect the owning session. Keep a separately started unrelated sentinel process for comparison.
expectedOutcomes: A loopback TCP connection may be established before authentication; an invalid envelope receives no command state.
The authenticated Start launches the owned child; on stop or shutdown observe that child exit and the unrelated sentinel remain alive. Escalation and disconnect timing must be observed, not assumed.

scenarios.title: Limit discussion attachments
plannedActions: In a scoped discussion attach an item and an image version, repeat one attachment, then attempt to exceed eight distinct attachments.
expectedOutcomes: Payloads retain their item and optional image-version IDs; the duplicate is not appended and no ninth attachment is added.

scenarios.title: Inspect header actions at the width threshold
plannedActions: In a signed-in workspace update the project title and account, inspect the header below and at 1440 width, and inspect its overflow actions.
expectedOutcomes: Header text updates, tabs stay centered, and expanded actions versus overflow follow the signed-in width threshold. Route behavior belongs to the controller.

scenarios.title: Import and export scripts with malformed input
plannedActions: Import known valid JSON and Fountain fixtures, export and reimport Fountain, then import a malformed .json payload and separately invalid UTF-8 bytes against the same project. Inspect persisted state after each refused input.
expectedOutcomes: Valid input and exported Fountain produce the intended script content. Malformed JSON and invalid UTF-8 fail without replacing the current project; arbitrary valid UTF-8 supplied as Fountain is not assumed invalid.

scenarios.title: Observe peer configuration, signal callbacks and retry status
plannedActions: In a future approved owned client fixture, attach project P, serve ICE configuration and two device records, deliver the same well-formed signal twice across polls, then fail a poll while attached; observe the client callback and status.
expectedOutcomes: Configuration returns iceServers, devices returns the server array without client eligibility filtering, the repeated signal invokes the callback once, and a non-cancelled polling failure reports Peer discovery reconnecting rather than returning or throwing signals.

scenarios.title: Separate update save and callback outcomes
plannedActions: In a proposed native updater harness, exercise allowed and disallowed host/feed policy and duplicate callback delivery using synthetic callback events.

Cancel at the initial save prompt; separately stage preparation and make the second save fail, observing retryBlocked and its warning. Label a simulated callback path and any real-Sparkle signed-package path separately.
expectedOutcomes: Initial save cancellation prevents continuation; stage-two failure reports that an already prepared update may install on quit and blocks retry.
Callbacks are one-shot for their generation; simulated callbacks establish neither package-signature validation nor actual installation.

scenarios.title: Edit script structure under leases
plannedActions: In a fixture with valid line leases add a line, split known text, merge the resulting lines and move a line; inspect selection and order, undo, and repeat split or merge without the required leases.
expectedOutcomes: The authorized actions produce the expected structure and undo restores the prior structure. Split requires its line lease and merge requires both line leases; a missing lease prevents that operation.

scenarios.title: Validate cue-scoped generation context
plannedActions: Run generation with a known cue and a controlled synthetic provider, recording its request context and target. Repeat with a cue lacking dialogue, active direction and visual override.
expectedOutcomes: The valid request uses the intended cue context; the empty context is rejected before a provider turn. A synthetic provider does not establish real provider execution.

scenarios.title: Use empty-script creation and import controls
plannedActions: Open an empty synthetic scene through the CLI and activate Add dialogue, then use the add bar Direction action. In a fresh empty scene activate Import script and choose a bounded synthetic text fixture.
expectedOutcomes: The first two actions create dialogue and direction entries respectively. Import invokes the script importer with the chosen fixture; do not infer split, merge or undo behavior from these controls.

scenarios.title: Retry a discussion message after uncertain acknowledgment
plannedActions: Have the controlled service accept a message while withholding or failing the acknowledgment, retry the unchanged draft, then send a new deliberate message after acknowledgment.
expectedOutcomes: The unchanged pending retry reuses the same message ID and the controlled server holds one message for that ID. A subsequent deliberate send can use a new ID.

scenarios.title: Validate multi-item cloud snapshots
plannedActions: Use a proposed controlled service fixture through the CLI to return a snapshot with two distinct live IDs and versions plus a valid tombstone; inspect the accepted project state.
Repeat with a wrong project ID, duplicate ID across live/deleted records, invalid tombstone flag and negative version.
expectedOutcomes: The valid snapshot preserves identified items and deletion metadata; each malformed snapshot is rejected before acceptance.
Event, lease and presence handling are separate and are not inferred from this snapshot check.

scenarios.title: Check time, count and error formatting
plannedActions: Use public CLI-visible examples or permitted static/compiler checks to cover zero, positive and negative durations, singular and plural counts, and each supplied ScrivError message.
expectedOutcomes: Labels follow the source format, count singular and plural forms differ as implemented, and each error description carries its supplied message. No implementation-only test suite is proposed.

scenarios.title: Filter and open project browser entries
plannedActions: Populate a disposable browser with known local and synthetic cloud/team projects; switch Recent, On this Mac, Scriv Cloud and Team projects, search a project title, select one result and open it. Search an absent title in a separate pass.
expectedOutcomes: Visible entries and footer identity correspond to the selected source and project; opening uses that project and an absent search shows the appropriate empty state. Scene lifecycle and sample construction are not asserted.

scenarios.title: Parse decimal-second audio timing drafts
plannedActions: Enter decimal-second strings including locale separator and values at bounds, negative, non-finite and malformed inputs; inspect accepted milliseconds and rendered seconds.
expectedOutcomes: Valid seconds round to bounded milliseconds and render as three-decimal seconds; invalid or out-of-range inputs are not accepted as valid drafts.

scenarios.title: Search and select tagged image versions
plannedActions: Open the picker for a known cue with multiple image versions tagged to characters, search a character alias and select a version; repeat with its local image missing.
expectedOutcomes: Search finds matching tagged images and selection assigns the intended immutable image ID. Missing local image displays the Not on this Mac fallback; portrait rendering is outside this picker.

scenarios.title: Create personal and team projects and rename an open project
plannedActions: Against a future approved isolated local service, create a personal project and a team T project, capture POST bodies and valid response decoding, then let account refresh succeed. Separately fail account refresh after a valid create response and inspect the surfaced error plus server project inventory without automatically retrying creation.
Rename open project P and attempt rename with no project open.
expectedOutcomes: POST /v1/projects sends title and optional teamId. The POST response is decoded first, then account refresh is awaited before returning the project. Refresh failure can throw after the server created the project; it does not establish that creation failed.
Rename PATCHes /v1/projects/P with title and returns no project; no open project causes no request.

scenarios.title: Inspect local cloud package commands
plannedActions: Inspect or run isolated cloud package local development, dry-run build and typecheck commands without remote deployment.
expectedOutcomes: The package describes its Node requirement and local Wrangler/typecheck scripts; no signed app, update feed or installation validation is inferred.

scenarios.title: Compare update acceptance snapshots
plannedActions: Using synthetic private snapshot data, compare an increasing build, changed executable, later new process and identical nonempty selected-project inventories; repeat with unchanged build, same PID or changed project bytes.
Separately use controlled download responses and signature verification failure; distinguish a stubbed verifier from a real signed macOS verification.
expectedOutcomes: A valid comparison reports matching protected project bytes and rejects each mismatched identity/process/inventory case.
Exact download requires pinned origin, feed and archive hashes and signature verification; a stub does not prove real signatures. This helper never installs, launches or publishes.

scenarios.title: Display direction end and peer edit lock
plannedActions: Open a synthetic scene with a direction starting at 2000 ms and coverage duration 3000 ms, select it, and inspect its details. In a separate peer-lock fixture hold a lock for the entry and inspect the label.
expectedOutcomes: The selected direction displays Applies through at the formatted 5000 ms time; a peer lock displays that peer as editing. Neither assertion claims timing-editor validation.

scenarios.title: Keep unconfirmed generated turn for inspection
plannedActions: In a planned owned CLI generation journey with an isolated synthetic JSON-RPC app-server fixture that drives the production CodexController, submit a prompt with bounded reference fixtures, capture thread and turn IDs, request cancellation, and withhold the final turn response or fail interrupt.
expectedOutcomes: Intent and copied references are journaled, turn/interrupt names the captured IDs, and an unconfirmed cancellation remains waiting for inspection. An interrupt request alone does not establish a stopped turn.

scenarios.title: Validate a cloud endpoint assignment
plannedActions: Set an allowed HTTPS or loopback endpoint and observe the target of a controlled request, then enter a remote HTTP URL and a credential-bearing URL.
expectedOutcomes: The permitted endpoint is used; invalid endpoint assignments retain the preceding valid endpoint and surface validation errors.

scenarios.title: Enforce a single CLI export handoff
plannedActions: Extend the owned CLI export journey to capture one synthetic handoff and then, in a separate operation, arrange two handoffs with both caller cleanup callbacks instrumented; after each capture attempt another normal export.
expectedOutcomes: One handoff and completion succeeds without a picker; two handoffs make the enclosing capture fail while invoking cleanup for both. The capture is disarmed after exit.

scenarios.title: Validate bootstrap request and grant boundaries
plannedActions: Using a permitted public client journey or static boundary checks, present approved and denied requests at age boundaries, replay a request UUID, mismatch pairing request or owner, and attempt a conflicting create-only grant.
expectedOutcomes: Invalid age, absent approval, replay or pairing mismatch are rejected at the respective checks; a conflicting existing grant is preserved. Signed-peer and live service ownership are separate XPC-boundary checks.

scenarios.title: Dispatch image prompt disclosure actions
plannedActions: On an exact mounted fixture image inspector use the CLI menu action to Show and Hide the captured generation prompt; repeat with a stale image and unsupported copy or share action.
expectedOutcomes: The supported disclosure actions dispatch semantically to the current image; stale target or unsupported actions are rejected or inert as implemented. This does not claim a physical native menu was opened.

scenarios.title: Discover a missing asset without re-fetching a local one
plannedActions: With one locally verified image and one missing known image, initiate discovery and a peer transfer in an isolated permitted setup; switch projects or request an unauthorized hash.
expectedOutcomes: The locally available asset does not need discovery, the known missing asset can be requested, and stale or unauthorized context does not install an unrelated replica.

scenarios.title: Resize a real alias-chip editor
plannedActions: Extend character-catalog with import-json of a character having aliases Al, Courier and a 120-character alias; open Characters > ribbon > Edit, avoiding the restricted Add alias alert route.

Plan a guarded public CLI window-resize/focus extension; inspect narrow/wide real chip bounds and Remove alias/Add alias keyboard-accessibility reachability. Cancel cleanly and compare the imported project.
expectedOutcomes: Actual chip widths are capped to available width and overflow wraps to later rows; resizing invalidates intrinsic height.

Full Remove alias labels remain available and buttons are reachable in the planned native journey. Resizing/clean cancel preserves aliases. Missing resize/input support is not-run, not a passing long-label substitute.

scenarios.title: Render an owned seeded portrait or review crop
plannedActions: Use a planned owned CLI seeded character review to show an allowlisted synthetic 2×2 PNG portrait or permitted crop, inspect the rendered view, then attempt an unowned asset, invalid region and changed navigation context.
expectedOutcomes: The allowed synthetic image or valid crop renders in its owning mounted screen. Invalid source, region or changed ownership/context is rejected; this helper is not a general command or evidence exporter.

scenarios.title: Serve validated update feed objects
plannedActions: Use synthetic R2 objects in a local Worker journey and request valid channel feed and digest-addressed artifact using GET and HEAD.
Try bad method/path, a feed whose bytes mismatch pointer hash and an artifact whose object metadata digest mismatches its path.
expectedOutcomes: Valid feed and artifact requests follow the configured GET/HEAD behavior; malformed route/method and specified mismatches are rejected.
The Worker hashes feed bytes but trusts artifact metadata for artifact routing; it does not check artifact bytes, signatures, icons or installed versions.

scenarios.title: Gate a Catalyst update on durable project work
plannedActions: On a disposable Catalyst fixture edit a project and request update preparation; separately inject a pending journal or save failure before handoff.
expectedOutcomes: A successful handoff follows completion and durable verification of pending work; an unresolved save or journal failure blocks handoff.

scenarios.title: Restore a chosen cloud revision and replay
plannedActions: With a future approved local client fixture, page project P history and snapshot at seq 7, then restore 7 and observe replay. Separately return a snapshot page whose headSeq differs from 7.
expectedOutcomes: Restore POST contains seq 7, commandId, sessionId, current epoch and expectedTimingVersion; its JSON result is discarded and replay refreshes state. A mismatched snapshot head is rejected; no restored value is returned.

scenarios.title: Fence a duration scrub and validate word transfer
plannedActions: For one cue preview a duration scrub and finish or cancel it, then attempt a second finish. Separately try a word transfer with valid and mismatched project, scene, navigation, revision, cue, and duplicate or empty IDs.
expectedOutcomes: The duration draft’s finished latch prevents a second finish and cancel does not commit. Word-transfer canApply is a stateless validation and alone does not establish one-shot mutation.

scenarios.title: Statically inspect the development build
plannedActions: Plan a disposable development-build shell harness on a suitable Darwin host with PATH stubs for xcodebuild, codesign, icon verification and supporting commands, using only synthetic build output. Capture Release/Debug options, unsigned initial build, command order and supplied entitlements.

Inject absent framework, nested component and helper separately and inspect nonzero exit; statically cross-check icon verifier and non-Darwin guard. Do not perform a build, sign real assets or install Xcode in this correction pass.
expectedOutcomes: The stub trace shows icon verification and inside-out signing: Installer.xpc, Downloader.xpc, Autoupdate, Updater.app, Sparkle.framework, plugin, runtime helper, then app; --deep is used for verification rather than signing.
Missing required components cause failure. Stubbed execution proves shell control flow only, not real signatures, package integrity, feed validity or installation.

scenarios.title: Import valid and invalid audio
plannedActions: Import a known valid audio sample into a captured scene, inspect its clip placement, then attempt a missing or invalid audio input.
expectedOutcomes: The valid input produces the intended scene clip; the invalid input reports failure without adding a clip.

scenarios.title: Recover pending project saves on ordinary startup
plannedActions: Stage a valid pending save and separately a malformed or failing record in a disposable root. Launch a safely isolated non-verification Catalyst startup and inspect replay or error; first establish that such a public launch route exists.
