expectedOutcomes: An accepted pending record can be recovered and a malformed or failing record is reported or retained as applicable. Standard CLI verification mode skips this startup recovery, so ordinary-startup coverage remains unverified without a safe route.

scenarios.title: Highlight words at timing boundaries
plannedActions: Create adjacent timed words and a gap, then seek to each word start and end and into the gap.
expectedOutcomes: The current word uses start-inclusive, end-exclusive intervals; a position in a gap has no current word.

scenarios.title: Run exact scenarios with owned-group evidence
plannedActions: In a disposable fixture repository list entrypoints and select an exact allowed scenario using the runner; separately force a preflight failure and run a controlled child that fails or times out.
Capture the retained run record, selected source/app identities and owned process-group cleanup result; compare a producer-declared coverage identity record only when present.

Through the public runner select workspace with a synthetic unsigned non-executable .app on Darwin and inspect retained prelaunch refusal evidence. Use permitted signed native runs for acceptance, and separately arrange controlled post-run/post-export signature invalidation without bypassing signing or launching modified code.
expectedOutcomes: On Darwin, an unsigned non-executable app fixture is rejected before any selected eligible native scenario starts, retains null app identity and the distinct app-signature-verification-failed blocker, and preserves the fixture bytes.

Successful identity handling for a signed bundle requires a real permitted native run. Post-run and post-export signature failures leave appUnchanged unknown and retain failure evidence. Coverage import is skipped after export identity failure.

Known selected entrypoints run in owned process groups. Evidence retains termination/exit or uncertain cleanup scope, with producer-declared source/build identity separate from cryptographic attestation.

scenarios.title: Display storage-health status priority
plannedActions: In an isolated project surface repository-unavailable, direction recovery, generation-journal and normal or failed-save states one at a time, including overlapping states.
expectedOutcomes: Displayed status follows the source priority and attention reflects the health conditions or recognized failure prefixes. History population is not inferred from its declaration.

scenarios.title: Preview one URL and observe finish editing separately
plannedActions: From an owned local project open Quick Look on one known fixture URL and inspect the preview item; separately trigger UIKitPresentation.finishEditing with a subscriber observing the notification.
expectedOutcomes: Quick Look supplies exactly the captured URL as its only preview item. The caller posts the finish-editing notification; this range only declares its name and does not post it.

scenarios.title: Import a selected synthetic PNG
plannedActions: Extend tracer app -- test --scenario journeys/local-images: import a synthetic project with selected cue image1 in an owned local workspace, no account/jobs/modal. Send import-local-image fixture coral then blue; compare returned dispatched/imported/cleanupVerified and loaded/persisted cue and asset metadata.

Repeat in fresh fixtures with unknown fixture token and with the inspector covering the workspace. Statically inspect unowned-run and root/package guards; do not fabricate execution of them or promise rollback after import has begun.
expectedOutcomes: Valid stable-scope imports return dispatched:true, imported:true, cleanupVerified:true. Coral SHA-256 is 827d9145314e931860ee40b45f8348ad3527c93e008d1490b687265d947fb577 and blue is 3fba282698b3df63c76fb40e529943fb6da6d28bafa6ff9e3a75c0c4a0cbb784; the existing cue identity and script entries remain unchanged.

Unknown token and covered workspace fail before importing and preserve saved content. Persistence is observed separately from imported status; cleanup failure is not silently interpreted as import failure.

scenarios.title: Manage invitations as a paid manager
plannedActions: Plan planned public CLI-driven native invitation journey against a local synthetic service: paid owner and separately admin open Invite, await team details, choose member/7 days, create then revoke the returned link and await each refresh.

As member/viewer inspect management notice and absent controls. In a manager fixture return a bounded server error from create/revoke and inspect issue label. Keep account/server stable; dismissal while loading does not imply server rollback.
expectedOutcomes: Creation uses selected role/days, shows only the newly returned URL and reloads details; successful revoke clears recentURL and reloads.

Nonmanagers see Invitations are managed by your team with no management controls. Operation failure shows the issue without fabricated success. No delivery or server cancellation guarantee is asserted.

scenarios.title: Publish a selected range as presence
plannedActions: In a shared project select a known start and end range within a known item, then inspect the controlled service or second client presence record.
expectedOutcomes: The presence update names the intended item ID and its exact selection start and end in the correct project.

scenarios.title: Inspect static migration inventory
plannedActions: In a disposable repository with a controlled Git baseline, run the inventory script to generate the ledger; inspect declaration, test, assertion, shell-line and UIKit-candidate records.
Run check against that ledger, then alter existing ledger data and attempt regeneration without overwriting the existing file.
expectedOutcomes: The inventory describes static candidates from the chosen baseline, not executed coverage.
A differing existing ledger is not overwritten; any exact exit status and flags follow the script help and are recorded in the future run.

scenarios.title: Navigate named workspace overflow actions
plannedActions: Open the workspace overflow menu on a synthetic project and choose Audio library, Discussion and Codex in separate runs; inspect discussion unread label and each destination.
Use the segmented control separately when testing workspace tabs.
expectedOutcomes: The menu lists and dispatches its named actions and reflects the unread discussion label; the segmented control, not this menu, selects workspace tabs.

scenarios.title: Validate entry shapes and word timing
plannedActions: Submit valid scene and script-entry records to a disposable local service, then independently use a malformed ID, an invalid UTF-16 character-link span and inconsistent/overlapping word timing.
expectedOutcomes: The syntactically valid records pass the field validator and the malformed fields fail.
Missing referenced scene or character records require a separate ProjectRoom.validateReferences case; field validation alone does not establish reference existence.

scenarios.title: Inspect secondary-menu attachment and drag
plannedActions: Plan planned public CLI-driven native Layers word-block secondary-click/Control-click using a future guarded physical route; inspect Edit word timing…, dismiss, then hold/drag the same real block and observe usability.

Statically inspect set(menu), set replacement, set nil and nil on new view; do not invent an app control to call the helper. Existing semantic menu-action is dispatch only, not evidence of native menu/long-press behavior.
expectedOutcomes: First nonnil set associates provider/interaction; later sets update menu. Nil causes no configuration but does not remove the interaction.

The planned gesture journey must show menu through secondary click without swallowing hold/drag; comments alone do not prove it. No canonical-digest or helper-owned secondary-click recognizer guarantee is made.

scenarios.title: Validate image metadata syntax
plannedActions: Submit an image record with correct hash, supported type, size, tags and well-formed previousVersionId to the local service; mutate hash, format, size, tags or lineage ID syntax one at a time.
expectedOutcomes: Field-valid metadata passes this validator and malformed fields fail.
A syntactically valid ID referring to a missing, later or cyclic version is not ruled out here; graph validation belongs to its actual owning layer.

scenarios.title: Record only eligible generated artifact paths
plannedActions: In a planned owned CLI generation journey using a synthetic local provider, emit imageGeneration notifications for one allowed in-directory PNG, its duplicate, a reference-prefixed file, an outside-directory path and an unsupported extension; inspect recorded artifacts and separately attempt later validation of a missing or oversized file.
expectedOutcomes: The allowed in-directory file URL is recorded once for the identical duplicate; the resolved path is used for containment. Recording itself does not establish regular-file status, size, readability or digest; those checks belong to later validation.

scenarios.title: Exercise client outbox, fences and replay gaps
plannedActions: In a future approved local client journey, attach a synthetic project, acquire and renew its lease, edit and interrupt after outbox persistence. Inject a 423 lease_required stale-fence rejection and, separately, a 409 stale_epoch rejection; inject an out-of-sequence event, then retry an accepted command with its original identity and reconnect. Separately fail transport without a definitive response.
expectedOutcomes: Before upload the exact payload is journaled. A 423 lease_required stale-fence response or 409 stale_epoch response marks the pending command .rejected; an uncertain transport failure retains the pending .json. A gap triggers replay rather than applying the out-of-sequence event. An accepted retry with the same identity does not duplicate the edit, and the accepted pending entry is removed.

scenarios.title: Check JSON value coding and exact strings
plannedActions: Use a proposed public fixture round-trip endpoint to encode/decode nested null, boolean, number, array and object values; submit equivalent objects with reversed key insertion order and malformed JSON.
Include two visually equivalent strings with different UTF-16 code units and inspect the resulting values and equality behavior through an explicit public observation route.
expectedOutcomes: Sorted-key encodings match for the reordered objects, nested values round-trip and malformed JSON errors.
The two distinct UTF-16 sequences compare unequal; a controlled service/CLI observation extension is required and no implementation-only unit suite is implied.

scenarios.title: Scroll selected scene and requested editing row
plannedActions: Open a synthetic project with two scenes and enough entries to scroll, select the second scene, then request editing of a known offscreen entry. Separately enable follow playback and advance the selected playing entry.
expectedOutcomes: Scene change scrolls its selected entry, requested editing begins on the matching row and scrolls it into view, and following playback scrolls the changed selected entry while playing.

scenarios.title: Route dialogue audio import to the selected entry
plannedActions: In an owned synthetic script with one dialogue D and one direction, open D’s entry menu and choose Import audio for this dialogue with an isolated fixture; inspect the import target. Inspect the direction menu separately.
expectedOutcomes: The dialogue action dispatches importAudio with D’s ID; the direction does not offer that dialogue-only action. Waveform and trim behavior are outside this range.

scenarios.title: Use the real runtime bootstrap adapter
plannedActions: Through a proposed public consent-gated bootstrap CLI journey, use the actual adapter and concrete native client to connect, observe the connection result, then disconnect.
If deterministic error injection is required, explicitly design and review a safe injection seam before implementing one.
expectedOutcomes: The adapter forwards connect and disconnect to its native client; there is no existing injected client double in this range and no test execution is claimed.

scenarios.title: Check scene fields and clock normalization separately
plannedActions: Through a project round-trip inspect ScriptScene identity, title and order and a WorkspaceTab raw value; separately use a permitted compiler or static check on a synthetic submillisecond date.
expectedOutcomes: Scene fields and tab value round-trip; ScrivClock.normalized, not scene decoding, rounds the synthetic date to milliseconds.

scenarios.title: Resolve one image review annotation
plannedActions: Analyze a synthetic fixture image with two known annotations, then confirm or ignore one through the review UI with necessary edit leases. Repeat with stale navigation or a denied lease.
expectedOutcomes: The selected annotation is resolved on its intended image and the other annotation remains unchanged; stale navigation or a denied lease prevents the attempted mutation.

scenarios.title: Check identity schema constraints
plannedActions: Extend the existing public CLI service journey with an isolated migration preflight: enable foreign keys, apply 0001 and insert user u1/github g1, session s1 and an auth code. In separate transactions try duplicate github_id, duplicate session ID, nonexistent session user and nonexistent auth-code user.
Read back u1, s1 and the original code after each failure; separately delete a user with a session but no auth-code reference to check session cascade.
expectedOutcomes: Duplicate github_id and session ID fail their unique constraints; missing user references fail their foreign keys and existing rows remain intact.
Deleting an otherwise unreferenced user cascades its session; auth_codes has a user foreign key without a declared cascade. These are planned checks, not executed results.

scenarios.title: Inspect selected and playing cue image states
plannedActions: Pause on a selected cue with no image ID, then select a cue with an assigned but locally missing image; play across cues and inspect preview and Inspect control.
expectedOutcomes: Paused preview follows selected cue and playing preview follows current cue. Inspect is disabled without an image ID but enabled for an assigned missing image, with the missing-image or fetch notice.

scenarios.title: Observe workspace initialization callbacks
plannedActions: Launch an isolated workspace, save a local edit and complete one controlled cloud or peer callback; inspect project and status state. Compare verification root and background generation-monitor configuration where observable.
expectedOutcomes: The local save and selected callback are reflected in the current workspace; verification mode uses its isolated repository and disables the applicable background monitor.

scenarios.title: Refresh account without clearing it on failure
plannedActions: Start with a known account, return successful account and device responses, then fail refresh; separately release an old-generation response after a newer request.
expectedOutcomes: Success updates the account, failure reports an error while retaining the prior account, and a stale generation must not replace newer state where the caller fences it.

scenarios.title: Record observed command completion
plannedActions: Enable owned coverage observation, issue one successful command, one failing command and one timed-out command; inspect recorded completion metadata and the actual state separately.
expectedOutcomes: Observation records returned success versus failure or uncertainty. A timeout does not prove that a mutation failed to occur.

scenarios.title: Show active progress then hide on stop
plannedActions: Plan a public CLI-driven native generation UI with owned synthetic project and delayed local synthetic provider fixture, no real provider access. Start through UI, hold completion, inspect stage/elapsed/spinner, then Cancel while still generating and delay acknowledgement.

Release fixture completion/cancellation and observe hiding. Inspect terminal status separately in jobs list. Statically verify timer update on generating/window transitions; screenshots alone cannot prove hidden timer invalidation.
expectedOutcomes: While generating, stage uses durable progress or controller status and elapsed uses job createdAt or view fallback with no time estimate.

Requested cancellation shows Requesting cancellation… and disabled Cancelling… while activity continues. isGenerating false hides view, stops spinner, clears elapsed and invalidates timer; a windowless view also invalidates it. No task-stop guarantee follows from the button press alone.

scenarios.title: Assign an image version to a cue
plannedActions: Create a cue and assign a known image version, then merge or delete a separate placement while comparing another cue.
expectedOutcomes: The target cue stores the intended image version and unrelated cues remain unchanged by the separate placement operation.

scenarios.title: Inspect exact-version placement titles
plannedActions: Extend public local-images/package-inspector journey with v1 in cues A/B, successor v2 in C, Ada portrait-only image and unplaced image. Open v1 inspector from B, then library context, then portrait/unplaced images.

For stale supplied cue now referencing v2, use coordinated public refresh or static caller check; include chosen exact-version cue with empty label and portrait association. Observe title and Show in script without assigning versions.
expectedOutcomes: Matching supplied cue B wins; otherwise first exact v1 placement A wins, never v2 placement. A nonempty chosen label wins, then Ada portrait, then Image.
Empty chosen cue label falls through instead of searching later cue labels. No search, assignment, byte-integrity or immutable-version mutation claim is attached.

scenarios.title: Inspect cloud migration and deploy composition
plannedActions: Statically inspect the package scripts and use stubbed local command tooling to observe preflight, typecheck and Wrangler argument composition without executing remote migration or deployment.
expectedOutcomes: The declared local/remote migrations and preflight-gated deploy composition are identified without deploying. Dependency versions and update-signing validation are separate concerns.

scenarios.title: Set line duration and direction coverage
plannedActions: Through separate controls set one line’s duration and one direction’s coverage endpoint, inspect their milliseconds and another entry, then submit an invalid duration.
expectedOutcomes: The two timing changes affect their intended targets; accepted seconds are finite, bounded to 0–3600 and rounded to milliseconds, while invalid input is rejected.

scenarios.title: Ingest cloud mentions and open a thread
plannedActions: Load project-scoped cloud history with a known mention, inspect mention state, then open and close a selected discussion with known thread messages.
expectedOutcomes: The history update ingests the mention and discussion presentation and messages follow the selected thread.

scenarios.title: Inspect asset catalog root metadata
plannedActions: Statically parse the root Contents.json and check its info.author and info.version metadata against the catalog schema, without packaging or updating an app.
expectedOutcomes: The root metadata contains the declared author/version values; it says nothing about signed updates, package acceptance or installed state.

scenarios.title: Select generation folders with valid and unreadable owners
plannedActions: In an isolated consent-gated folder-picker fixture, select a generation folder containing one valid owner different from the current installation, then separately a folder with two valid owners. Select a third folder containing one valid record plus one invalid-owner record; inspect adopted owner, loaded jobs and unreadable warning without submitting generation.
expectedOutcomes: A sole valid loaded owner is adopted even when it differs from the current installation; mixed valid loaded owners reject selection. Invalid-owner records are counted unreadable and preserved rather than making the whole folder necessarily fail; the UI reports the unreadable warning.

scenarios.title: Audit overlapping local intent counts
plannedActions: Plan a public owned Script/word-timing journey that overlaps two edit scopes on item A by holding a save pending as the second opens; finish one scope, then the other. Repeat with independent item B and a terminal unmatched end through a permitted public fixture.
Observe lease retention/release and local intent through a bounded planned CLI observer; statically trace WorkspaceStore.beginEdit before lease await and endEdit after pending save.
expectedOutcomes: A remains in the local intent set after one of its two scopes finishes and clears only after the second; B is independent and an unmatched end is a no-op.
Caller lease effects must be observed in the real journey and are not evidence of distributed convergence, durable receipts or revocation.

scenarios.title: Apply cloud items and compare changed IDs
plannedActions: Use a synthetic project with two entries and local audio clips, capture encoded item set, edit one identified entry through the CLI and use a proposed public observation route to inspect the changed item IDs passed by WorkspaceStore.

Return a complete valid item set through a controlled service, including removal of an anchored entry, then separately return a data.id/item.id mismatch or duplicate identity; exercise PeerSignal encode/decode in its own public fixture.
expectedOutcomes: The diff identifies the changed item, the complete valid set rebuilds project collections and retains valid items; local clips whose scene/entry anchor disappeared are removed.
Mismatched or duplicate identities fail; peer-signal coding is a separate check and needs an observable fixture.

scenarios.title: Separate cancelled and successful login attempts
plannedActions: In an isolated connected synthetic runtime fixture, start login A, cancel A, return a signed-out account response and deliver a late completion for A. Then explicitly start fresh login B, complete B with a matching success response and return a signed-in account response.
Invoke sign-out with successful logout and signed-out account read; separately make the post-logout account read fail and inspect retained prior state and surfaced failure.
expectedOutcomes: The cancelled login completion is ignored. Fresh matching login B updates account state from its response. A successful logout followed by a signed-out read clears displayed account readiness. If the post-logout read fails, the prior accountLabel/authentication fields remain but accountChecked becomes false, so setup shows its checking/unverified state rather than the prior ready display.

scenarios.title: Check membership and invitation constraints
plannedActions: Extend the public CLI service journey migration preflight in disposable storage with foreign_keys=ON; insert known user/team/member/link rows. In separate transactions insert a missing team/user reference, duplicate membership, member role editor, missing link team/creator, duplicate token_hash and link roles owner/admin.
Read back original team, membership and link after every failed insert; inspect the declared cascades separately.
expectedOutcomes: Foreign-key, composite-primary-key, unique and role-CHECK constraints reject the corresponding invalid rows and preserve existing fixtures.
Membership permits owner/admin/member/viewer and join links permit member/viewer. This planned migration preflight does not establish application authorization.

scenarios.title: Split a cue and retime a word
plannedActions: Use a timed scene to split a known cue, move its shared cut and retime a known word. Separately attempt a stale split preview or invalid word timing.
expectedOutcomes: The specified cue and word boundaries reflect the accepted edits; the stale or invalid operation does not commit an unrelated change.

scenarios.title: Release only after a valid profile token
plannedActions: Plan a public CLI coverage collector journey with synthetic owned transport responses: reconstruct a multi-chunk valid profile and independently hash its bytes. Capture commands issued for an invalid snapshot token and, separately, a syntactically valid token followed by wrong identity, malformed chunk, digest mismatch and success.
Use a planned bounded fault-injection extension to the public transport; on a valid token inject release failure both after success and after an earlier primary failure.
expectedOutcomes: An invalid token is rejected before the try/finally and causes no release command. A valid token leads to one release attempt on success or any later failure, not a guarantee that cleanup succeeded.
Successful reconstruction respects 16 MiB total and 128 KiB chunk bounds and matches SHA-256. A release error replaces success, while an earlier failure remains primary.

scenarios.title: Capture attributable coverage session metadata
plannedActions: In an instrumented owned CLI session capture before and after profiles around two known commands, then attempt an unrelated session or context.
expectedOutcomes: Records identify session, build and command context and are kept separate; cumulative counters may include polling, capture transport and overlapping background work, so they are not exclusive causal attribution.

scenarios.title: Resolve explicit or default generation root
plannedActions: In an owned CLI run, select a valid synthetic generation history and inspect its resolved root; make that configured folder unavailable and try again. In a separate fresh run with no configured folder inspect the appropriate verification or app-support root.
expectedOutcomes: A valid configured folder is used; its unavailable state raises an error rather than silently replacing it with empty history. No configured folder selects the corresponding default Generation root.

scenarios.title: Inspect crop and missing compact portrait
plannedActions: Extend public character catalog/link review with a synthetic package: A has a known local PNG and matching portraitRegion imageID/digest; B has unavailable portrait bytes. Open A and inspect its crop with bounded rendered-image evidence; repeat with only crop ID or digest mismatched.

Open the script character-link review for B, which uses the real 56-by-58 avatar. Inspect placeholder accessibility and close without saving. The required public review observer may be a planned extension.
expectedOutcomes: Crop rendering is chosen only when both crop image ID and digest match the resolved asset; mismatches use the normal image view.

B compact missing avatar exposes character-portrait-placeholder, value No portrait on this device and Portrait of B label. Larger missing images are not asserted to use this compact view; inspection does not edit assets.

scenarios.title: Check generation receipt schema keys
plannedActions: Extend the existing public CLI generation service journey with an isolated migration preflight. Insert project p and jobs a and b, then operations (p,a,op1) and (p,b,op1) with distinct request_hash, actor_session_id and resulting_version.
Try a duplicate (p,a,op1), inspect retained metadata, then delete job a and inspect its operation while job b remains; enable foreign keys.
expectedOutcomes: Both distinct job-scoped keys are accepted; the duplicate compound key fails and existing metadata remains intact.
Deleting job a cascades its operations without deleting b’s; the schema itself does not implement request-hash replay semantics.

scenarios.title: Toggle pictured tags on one image
plannedActions: Open Who is pictured for a known image, toggle a known character on, close and reopen, then toggle it off and compare an unrelated image and prompt.
expectedOutcomes: The chosen image’s tag reflects each saved toggle; the unrelated image and prompt remain unchanged.

scenarios.title: Preview and fence duration hold-drag
plannedActions: Plan planned public CLI-driven native Script duration-button hold>=0.18s and drag: 3000ms three-word dialogue, up10points previews3200 then release once after lease readiness. Fresh direction/dialogue fixtures cross minima and one-hour maximum; inspect saved model before release.

Cancel, finish unchanged and repeat terminal event through planned guarded gesture input. Coordinate source/navigation/scene change during delayed lease through public local fixture; statically check unreachable exact races rather than directly instantiate the draft.
expectedOutcomes: Preview is rounded(originalMs-translationY*20), direction minimum0, dialogue minimum max(1,wordCount), maximum3600000. Nonfinite translation is ignored.

Finish applies once only for changed duration with exact original entry/UTF-16 text, navigation and scene. Unchanged/cancelled/repeated/stale cases apply nothing; driver stale notice is separate from helper return. Word-overlap validation is outside scope.

scenarios.title: Recover a scoped cue-direction draft
plannedActions: Edit a selected cue direction and interrupt before the project save completes in a disposable workspace. Reopen, alter the underlying source or switch project, and inspect the recovered draft.
expectedOutcomes: Recovery stays associated with the original cue and project; a changed source requires rebase rather than silently applying the draft elsewhere. Feasibility of controlling this boundary remains to be established.

scenarios.title: Reject invalid character analysis regions
plannedActions: Run a planned owned character-image review journey with a local synthetic analysis provider: return one valid normalized detection, then separately a zero-width or out-of-bounds region. Confirm or ignore a valid annotation and reapply an overlapping detection.
expectedOutcomes: Valid detection is applied; invalid region is rejected without mutating the project. A confirmed or ignored decision survives a matching reanalysis. The synthetic provider is not actual Codex execution.

scenarios.title: Measure script callback count deltas
plannedActions: In one owned isolated run take script-interaction-counts before and after one actual merge-at-start callback, and separately before/after one on-text-edit callback; try observation with an invalid run root.
expectedOutcomes: The corresponding cumulative count increases by the observed callback count, and an invalid run root is rejected.
Counts do not establish input event history, successful mutation, source hashes or executable provenance.

scenarios.title: Validate Catalyst build configuration
plannedActions: Use a disposable valid template and SDK configuration and inspect planned compiler flags and copied resources; separately try invalid coverage flag combinations, versions, overlapping paths and malformed templates.
expectedOutcomes: Valid isolated inputs yield the intended setup; each specified invalid configuration is rejected at the appropriate validation stage. Compiler success and full app packaging are separate claims.

scenarios.title: Read and release owned profile snapshots
plannedActions: Plan public JSON-line coverage-snapshot twice in a matching coverage-enabled owned app, reject a third outstanding snapshot, read a token in chunks <=131072, hash reconstructed bytes, release it and reject stale reads/releases.

Reject boolean/fractional/negative offsets, offset==byteCount, length 0/131073 and extra keys. Cold relaunch and try the old token. Statically check the 16777216-byte maximum and full-copy guard rather than invent an oversized runtime profile.
expectedOutcomes: Snapshots are nonempty cumulative llvm-profraw, <=16 MiB, with at most two retained; final chunk may be shorter and gives correct nextOffset/eof. Reconstructed SHA-256 matches metadata.

Malformed, stale or foreign-session requests fail. Release removes the snapshot; zeroing/deallocation is a static implementation observation. No executable/source manifest validation, causal attribution or global atomicity is claimed.

scenarios.title: Compile the update-bridge consent interface
plannedActions: Use a permitted compiler check against the declared header and expected callback and Boolean-consent signature. Cover denial and session behavior separately through the actual adapter/client journey.
expectedOutcomes: The header provides the declared ABI surface; its declaration alone does not prove that denying consent prevents a session.

scenarios.title: Check portrait cache and verification refusal
plannedActions: In a proposed isolated native public journey with a temporary cache root, select an oriented synthetic source image and valid normalized portrait crop twice; inspect the PNG dimensions/pixels and repeated output key.
On fresh cache keys try an invalid crop and a mismatched source digest. Separately invoke the same path in a CLI automation build.
expectedOutcomes: A cache miss checks crop and source digest before orientation-corrected PNG creation; the same key returns the cached path without rereading or revalidating original bytes.
Invalid crop and mismatched digest on a cache miss fail; CLI automation returns the explicit unavailable error. A safe temporary-cache/public observation extension is required for the non-CLI branch.

scenarios.title: Observe team details completed out of order
plannedActions: Request details for team A, then B; complete B first and release A later. Inspect the shared details value after each completion.
expectedOutcomes: The shared value may reflect the latest completed response, including late A; the current code does not establish selected-team fencing. Any desired stale-response rejection is a separate unresolved regression.

scenarios.title: Start and pause playback with preparation
plannedActions: Arrange a fixture where editing preparation vetoes playback, then permit it, start playback, observe clock progress, seek and pause.
expectedOutcomes: A veto prevents start; successful playback advances through its clock task, and pause cancels that task and invokes the pause callback. The callbacks themselves are not the clock.

scenarios.title: Surface peer transfer status
plannedActions: Request an eligible known-hash peer image and observe receipt and verification status; separately fail a transfer or request a rejected hash.
expectedOutcomes: A verified receipt can surface its success status; a failed or rejected transfer must not be presented as a verified successful receipt.

scenarios.title: Observe Catalyst bootstrap state
plannedActions: Launch a disposable Catalyst fixture with controlled bootstrap completion and a status update, and inspect state before and after completion.
expectedOutcomes: Catalyst starts in the bootstrapping state and changes it on completion; the status reflects the surfaced update. No equivalent non-Catalyst startup indicator is assumed.

scenarios.title: Inspect generation client request encoding
plannedActions: Use a controlled local service and a public CLI fixture extension to record list/get/create/claim/update requests for synthetic project and job IDs, including path escaping, lowercased job/operation IDs, source revision and expected version.
Return two pages, a repeated cursor and a response after project/account context changes; send PATCH progress containing newline and over 160 UTF-16 units plus valid and invalid error codes.
expectedOutcomes: Pagination combines and sorts advancing pages, rejects a repeated cursor and cancels a stale-context list.

Create/claim/PATCH carry the specified fields; progress newlines become spaces and truncates at 160 UTF-16 units, while invalid error code is rejected before PATCH. Output attachment deduplication belongs elsewhere.

scenarios.title: Capture the owned Fountain handoff
plannedActions: Open a synthetic project in the current isolated workspace and call export-fountain without any destination; compare returned UTF-8 Fountain text to expected content and inspect reported cleanup.
Try the command in an unowned workspace and separately with an extra destination request field.
expectedOutcomes: The real synchronous Script.fountain handoff returns bounded text and its checked cleanup result.
Unowned workspace and unsupported extra fields are rejected; there is no caller-selectable export destination.

scenarios.title: Fall back from hosted image fetch to peer
scenarios.restriction: The isolated native CLI reports peer transport disabled. Receiving bytes from an eligible second Mac requires a supported peer route.
plannedActions: Request a locally missing known image, fail its hosted download and offer a valid replica from an eligible peer; repeat with no eligible peer or invalid bytes.
expectedOutcomes: The valid known replica can be verified and installed; no eligible peer or invalid bytes leaves the asset unavailable and surfaces a recoverable failure or status.

scenarios.title: Scan a character image through the owned Codex fixture
plannedActions: Import a synthetic project and image, disable automatic tagging, connect the owned local Codex fixture in Settings and select Scan again. Repeat with an unconfirmed sandbox and with an unexpected tool notification.
expectedOutcomes: The scan saves the recognized character and a review candidate while preserving the image and script. The unconfirmed sandbox receives no image and unexpected tool activity triggers a turn interrupt. Both failures preserve the saved scan.
